filament_notes: GeeeTech PETG Transparent 1.75 mm, 1 kg. Geeetech and 3DJake: nozzle 220-240 C, bed 80-90 C; density 1.27 (Open Filament Database). Tune: 235/240 C, flow 1.00, cap 8 mm3/s, fan 0 percent on layers over 20 s rising to 50 percent on short layers, bridges 100 percent, for clarity. Based on the ICE Rob clear tune (220 C, 7 mm3/s, no fan) and the GeeeTech white tune (flow 0.98, 10 mm3/s). Check flow and PA on a real print. T8 version for the 1.0 mm high-flow nozzle: Prusa has no 1.0 PETG, so temperature, cap and fan follow Prusa Prusament PETG @COREONE HF0.8 (260 C, 37 mm3/s, fan 30-65, bridges 65, layer time 20/35 s) scaled to this filament and to INDX; pressure advance is the 0.4 value x0.447 (Prusa 0.4 to 0.8 ratio) x0.69 (0.8 to 1.0 step used for the CF profiles). Raise the cap with a max-flow test.
